# CFG001 missing-materialized-knob

A materialized config knob is missing from the product config file.

## What it does

Every knob that affects behavior must be written down with its default so no variable is invisible. A missing file counts as every knob missing.

## Why it matters

A knob that is not in the file is invisible to whoever reads the configuration.

## Remedy

Run `frob init` (or `frob config sync`) to add the missing knobs.

## Examples

### A violating case fires

```rust expect=fire file=src/lib.rs
pub fn placeholder() {}
```

### A conforming case is clean

```rust expect=clean file=src/lib.rs
pub fn placeholder() {}
```

## Examples

### CFG001 enforcement knob missing from the materialized file / A file missing knobs fires #1 (line 8) (fire)

```toml
[tickets]
cas_retries = 5
```

### CFG001 enforcement knob missing from the materialized file / An empty file fires #2 (line 15) (fire)

```toml
# nothing materialized
```

### CFG001 enforcement knob missing from the materialized file / A file with every knob is clean #3 (line 21) (clean)

```toml
[tickets]
cas_retries = 5
ref = "trunk"

[tickets.lease]
ttl_minutes = 120
```
